services.desc: Fun and Dynamic Results Based Pittsburgh Personal Training and Pittsburgh Classical Pilates training in the comfort of your own home!A convenient and time saving way to get your body in the sleek and sexy shape you have always dreamed about. No more excuses! Every session includes:- A structured warm up (focusing on the core)- Muscular and strength endurance- Isolation stretching targeting your imbalances- Mind-body cool down- Nutrition guidance and Fitness educationNo equipment needed… Lynsey provides some small apparatus props: resistance bands, light kettlebells, and medicine balls! Trust me, you don’t need a full equipped gym to get in shape!! Programs are individually based. Sessions
